title: Restless hearts also need love
summary: This meets the mind that keeps moving because it has forgotten what it is moving toward. The line joins aimless wandering to a heart missing love for the Lord.
takeaway: Let love quiet the wandering mind.
lifeApplication: When the mind runs from input to input, stop before the next one lands. Ask what love for the Lord would make unnecessary right now.

source.shortMeaning: Restlessness deepens when the heart lacks love for the Lord.
source.lifeApplication: When the mind scatters, ask what hunger beneath it is still unloved.

evidence.coreClaim: Restlessness deepens when the heart lacks love for the Lord.
evidence.turn: Love for the Lord gathers what distraction keeps scattering.
